_comment: Suggested next commands after a successful main-flow command, as meta.next_commands. {a|b} takes the first of these that resolves: a dotted path into the result data (datasets.0.id), arg.NAME (a positional), or inv.known_dataset_id. {?a|b} is optional: left out when nothing resolves. A template with a required placeholder that does not resolve is skipped. At most three are returned. A key ending in .* covers every command under that prefix.

dashboard.v3.generate: mammoth dashboard figure add {dashboard_id|id} --input '{"intent": "DESCRIBE THE CHART"}'
